parent_objective: design full public gate for the M974 exact-repaired base-start candidate after exact M297/M270 and first replay pass
blocked_by: M974 selected candidate has only first replay evidence, not full public gate evidence
invalidates: promotion of M974 candidate before full public proof/generalization/behavior gates

public_gates: M975 must not use private holdout
M975 must preserve the P0 actor-input contract
M975 must design six-surface proof replay for the M974 selected candidate
M975 must design fresh public/moderate-OOD and behavior/ablation gates before promotion audit
forbidden_shortcuts: do not promote from first replay only
do not skip M267/M264 full-surface replay
do not skip old public proof surfaces

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_ppo_readiness: full gate for exact-repaired post-PPO candidate
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs the full public proof/generalization/behavior gate after M974 first replay pass
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design-only full public gate milestone; no checkpoint promotion or private holdout claim
stop_condition: stop if full gate would rely on private holdout
stop if design skips any of the six public replay surfaces
stop if design conflates full-gate candidate with promotion
fallback_plan: if full public gate design is too broad, split proof replay and generalization gates into separate milestones
if proof overfit risk is high, add source-diverse diagnostic reporting before promotion audit
if candidate fails implementation, route to objective-coverage audit rather than PPO escalation
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M974 selected an exact-repaired candidate after first replay pass

hypothesis: The M974 base-start exact-repaired candidate should be evaluated through the full public proof/generalization/behavior stack before any promotion audit.
success_criteria: M975 writes a full public-gate design document
the design names the selected M974 checkpoint and alpha_1_0 baseline
the design requires six public replay surfaces
the design requires fresh public, moderate OOD, and behavior/ablation comparisons
the design blocks PPO, private holdout, and promotion
failure_criteria: design promotes from first replay only
design allows PPO continuation before full gate
decision_rule: M975 is complete only when M976 has a proof-first full public gate design and still blocks promotion until a later audit.
